resources.string: Next step

This keeps the failed task unchanged. The browser may show a different page. Inspect that current page again and explicitly select a newly detected resource; method, access, destination and permission checks still apply.
Return to browser to inspect again
Check the currently selected page. When it is ready, tap Inspect and choose to inspect it again, then choose a new resource. The failed task remains unchanged; nothing has started automatically.
Dismiss guidance
You cancelled this task. No retry or method switch will follow. Start a separate task only if you choose to.
Do not switch methods to bypass content protection or access restrictions. This task stays stopped; use a source you are permitted to save.
Check the site address and its secure connection with the site owner. Do not bypass certificate warnings or retry through another saving method.
Check available space and storage access before starting another task. Manage files yourself if needed. This guidance does not delete existing media or retry the task.
Wait for existing verification or recovery checks. If still unavailable, reopen the app and review the task status before starting new work. Retained files are not proof of a successful save.
Do not start another method while resource release is unconfirmed. Exit and reopen the app, then review recovery status. Retained task files will not be deleted by this guidance.
Wait for current media work to finish or stop safely, then review its status. No parallel retry or recording will be started here.
Return to the browser and check that you have access, signing in normally if needed. Then inspect the current page again. Do not use another method to bypass a refusal.
The old resource cannot be reused safely. Return to the browser, check the current page and inspect again. Any selected replacement creates a separate task from the beginning.
Check the network and site availability, then inspect the current page again when ready. A network failure does not establish that another method will work.
Wait before contacting the site again. When its limit has cleared, return to the browser and inspect again manually; no automatic retries will be started here.

Inspect the current page again to check for supported resources. A newly detected MP4 may offer ① Direct; supported HLS may offer ② Stream with the required entitlement. Neither is guaranteed. Independent recording still requires your own setup and system consent and cannot bypass protection.
The output did not pass validation. Inspect the current page again and select a fresh supported resource if available. The failed output is not a saved video.
This version reached its size or transfer limit. Review the limits before choosing a smaller supported resource in a separate task. Switching methods does not remove those limits.
Review the task error and app status before trying again. If it repeats, you can export redacted diagnostics from Settings. No method is assumed to be available.
System capture consent was declined. The task stays stopped. Only if you change your mind, open recording settings yourself and explicitly start a new session with fresh consent.
Review audio choices in recording settings. A silent recording requires your explicit choice and a new start; audio permission is not retried and the microphone is never substituted.
Review the supported recording configuration and system availability in recording settings. Start a separate session only when ready, with fresh system consent.
Review the recording error and any retained segments in recording settings. Only verified output counts as saved. A new session requires your explicit start and fresh system consent.
This navigation has already been used. Inspect the current browser page to continue.
The task changed or is no longer available. Review its latest details before choosing a next step.
This task does not allow this next step. Review its failure guidance instead.
This action is temporarily unavailable. Wait for current media work or resource release to finish, then try again. Nothing has been started.
